text: 05:30Z check-in. All 18 lanes have running swarms and none is idle, so no successors were started and no messages were sent. The S2 gate is ready to close. All four reviews are in: L-S1 47 PASS / 5 conditional, L-S2 7/7 PASS, L-S3 36/36 PASS, L-S4 48 PASS / 4 FAIL. The reviews agree on the evidence. They differ only on whether a leftover `omit … in` line counts as a FAIL. Under the standing rule this is resolved: each of the four `omit … in` lines is deleted together with its declaration, at Compactness:164, BoundedFunctions:214, Factors:276 and Separability:52. The five conditional pairs are also deleted together, and none of the 52 names is used outside the set. Two notes for the desk. (1) L-S4 says a leftover modifier would 'silently' change a theorem statement. That is overstated. An `omit` of an instance the next declaration needs causes a compile error, and an `omit` of an unneeded instance does nothing; L-S2 confirmed that stacked `omit` lines compile and are idempotent. The real hazard is BoundedFunctions:214, where `omit … in` followed by `end` is a parse error. (2) Deleting palette_transfer_pair and palette_second_exclusion removes the Lean anchor for manuscript Lemma 5.2(1). The exposition mapping must be updated in the same commit. A grep check does not show that the proofs still compile; only the local 67-module rebuild can. New evidence reviewed: (a) a6_signtable.py, an independent recheck: the A6 SignTable solution is unique and dropping one disjointness constraint gives 64 solutions, consistent with SignTable.lean; (b) the m6 field-vs-exists separation (729 palette fields satisfy the existential form, exactly 1 the phase-pinned form) confirms the bridge must conclude the phase-pinned form; (c) R1-3: strict MC120 is ACCEPT with corrections C1–C7 and Corollary P is ACCEPT for k=6 only (G1/G2). C7, whether rigidity holds at the specific chord direction, is the one open item and waits on m5/m12. (d) L-N4 proved that 2-list regions contain no unit edges, so certificates must come from the 3-list regions. (e) m5: any odd walk inside H from q_min to q_plus has length ≥13; n=13 is still undecided. The Lean queue is idle (140 passed). No reviewed .lean inbox artifact was supplied this cycle, so I made no Lean proposals; I am staging the three standalone formal sources instead.
summary: S2 gate: 4 independent reviews, no surviving dependency on any of the 52 names; deletion set = 52 declarations + 4 omit lines, with conditional pairs deleted together; the local rebuild decides. A6 SignTable: unique solution, independently rechecked twice; the adjacency constraint is load-bearing. Field vs exists: pinned 1 vs existential 729, so bridge-r2-G3's existential conclusion is too weak for A5 and the pinned form is required. Strict MC120 accepted with corrections C1–C7, with C7 (chord-direction selection) still open; Corollary P is k=6 only. 2-list regions have no unit edges (min cross-patch distance >1 strictly, within-patch ≤0.8966), so the L-N4 target moves to 3-list regions with |z|=1/2 antipodal edges. Odd q_min→q_plus walk in H has n≥13 (m5, proof checked); n=13 open. No global chromatic improvement.
